SELECT 
  t.fished_date_doy, 
  COUNT(*) as trip_count, 
  ROUND(AVG(t.yt), 3) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  ROUND(SUM(t.yt) / SUM(t.anglers), 3) as fleet_yt_per_angler,
  MAX(t.yt) as max_yt_trip
FROM trips t
WHERE t.fished_date_doy >= 260 AND t.fished_date_doy <= 280
  AND t.fished_date_season = 2
GROUP BY t.fished_date_doy
ORDER BY t.fished_date_doy
